annotations.title: Find the RBI purpose code for a payment

description: RBI purpose codes that fit a payment or receipt described in plain words, best first, each with its bank form (Form A1 / A2), Form 145 / 146, income-tax nature, GST and reporting.

direction.description: inward = money received from abroad (P codes), outward = money paid abroad (S codes), any = both.

query.description: What the money is for, e.g. 'software development for a US client'.
